_note: Written by npm run precompute; do not edit. Average hours of direct sun per day, 04-15, 06-21, 08-15, every 30 min, buildings as the only shade. Grid cells row by row from the south-west corner (origin_m, map metres from the kit centre), west to east, then northwards. classes: one character per cell, 0 = building, 1 = shade, 2 = partial shade, 3 = full sun. hours_x10: sun hours × 10 per cell (0 for buildings).
